components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary action button with electric magenta fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #B600A8; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; shadow: 0px 4px 12px rgba(182, 0, 168, 0.3); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #900085; transform: scale(1.05); }

components.name: Secondary Outline Button
components.description: Outline pill button with ice silver border.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #0C0C0C; color: #D7E2EA; padding: 12px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; border: 1px solid rgba(215, 226, 234, 0.3); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: #D7E2EA; color: #0C0C0C; }

narrative.overview: The design system for Yehia Amin's personal portfolio is a high-contrast, obsidian-dark digital interface built around precision engineering, high-tech aesthetics, and immersive 3D depth.

rules.name: The Neon Rarity Rule
rules.body: Neon accent colors are reserved strictly for key interactive elements, badges, and focal points. They occupy ≤15% of any screen surface.

rules.name: The Dark Layering Rule
rules.body: Depth is created through surface contrast and thin borders, relying on ambient neon glow rather than traditional light drop shadows.

dos: Do maintain deep obsidian #0C0C0C as the primary background color.
Do use Kanit with bold uppercase styling for major headings.
Do apply rounded-full to interactive pill buttons and status tags.
donts: Don't use light background colors for main sections.
Don't overuse electric neon accent colors on body text or wide background areas.
Don't use sharp 0px corners on interactive cards or modals.
